content: Web Crypto API AES-GCM is the native, audited browser primitive for encryption; prefer it over third-party JS crypto. Never reuse an IV with the same key (12-byte IV standard). Derive keys via PBKDF2/Argon2 from master password rather than storing raw keys; keep keys as non-extractable CryptoKey objects. Decrypted secrets sitting in browser process memory are still vulnerable to memory-dump/injection attacks -- minimize decrypted lifetime and clear buffers after use. Never log ciphertext/IV in production.
